environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB is internet-facing with a default listener on port 443 forwarding to the target group. No IP-based restrictions are configured on the ALB security group (0.0.0.0/0 ingress on port 443). The service uses Spring's JavaMailSender backed by an internal SMTP relay (Postfix) that does not perform header injection filtering. The application.properties sets spring.mail.host=internal-smtp.acme.local with no authentication required.
